target.statement: Deterministic proof layer for AI agent claims — a typed-grammar, trace-backed, solver-verified system that proves what follows from given facts and hardcoded rules, and rejects any claim that does not. Agents never author rules; rules are compiled grammar. Proof only, never branch.
non_negotiable: Rules are hardcoded in the grammar; the agent cannot inject or judge them.
No if/else branching in the agent-facing surface — proof shows X therefore Y, never if A then B else C.
Every result is trace-backed to a truth/root fact through valid transformations.
Missing satisfiability conditions on a transformation raise — compiler semantics, not soft-unknown.
target.what_is_verified: Agent claims across domains: whether a stated plan/result/value follows from given facts and the domain grammar, via induction/deduction with solver checkable preconditions.
what_is_beyond_control: Statistical semantics (tone, style) — LLM-judge, not proof.
External non-verifiable claims with no formalizable ground model.
Full autonomous action-gating enforcement in production infrastructure.

reasoning_modes.direction_detail: One transformation definition supports both — forward (output=f(inputs)) and backward (inputs>=needed(output)). Precondition checks identical in both. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.

operations.title: Operations (logistics, finance, planning)
operations.note: Highest-value next family; needs Z3 backend for discrete satisfiability.

core_engine.evidence: deduce + induce implemented; DAG dedup + ancestor-loop guard enforced; 20/20 benchmark. See openwiki/architecture/engine.md.

z3_backend.why: Required for operations family (discrete constraints) and for conflicts() unsat-core extraction.
z3_backend.contract: Register 'z3.sat' hook in SOLVERS; derive minimal violated rule subset -> 'why not'.

statistical_llm_judge.why: Interface shape retained only; judge not built. Distinct confidence-scored verdict from symbolic verdict.

mcp_server.why: ARCHITECTURE.md 7.3 spec only; no mcp module, no serve subcommand. Agent boundary: expose verify() only, never fact store or rule text.

playground_web.why: Future. Will ingest status/*.json directly. Rigorous public demo per grammar, shows scalability.

decisions.title: Grammar source is Python code, not .ovpl files
decisions.decision: Grammar fact-kinds and rules live in grammars/<domain>.py modules. spec/ovpl/proof.ovpl is superseded sketch, not source of truth.
decisions.rationale: No lifted spec layer to drift from code; the Python module is the executable grammar. AVOIDS dual source-of-truth.

decisions.title: No satisfy()/verify() boolean in agent surface
decisions.decision: Agent-facing surface exposes only facts (autovar) and transformations. Runtime engine alone fires rules; decisions are derivations in the trace, never agent code branches.
decisions.rationale: A bool hands the agent a fork and a fabrication path. Proof shows X therefore Y only.

decisions.title: Missing satisfiability conditions throw, not soft-unknown
decisions.decision: Attempting a transformation without required precondition inputs raises at runtime (compiler semantics). Preserve UNKNOWN only for 'target not derivable with everything provided'.
decisions.rationale: Missing operand is a compile error, not a runtime warning. Distinguishes agent error from genuine undecidability.

decisions.title: Operation taxonomy is reality-gated
decisions.decision: An operation enters designed/ only with a concrete input/output contract in SCHEMA.md section 3. Vague labels ('derive', 'entails', 'frontier') are rejected until shown by example.
decisions.rationale: Protects main design decisions from contamination by aspirational bluff op types.

decisions.title: Decision-making is first-class in the database
decisions.decision: Every domain carries a chronological decisions log; cross-cut decisions live in this file. A decision without recorded rationale is not a decision.
decisions.rationale: AOs and future contributors must see why choices were made, not just what was built.
